# Terramorph LLC

> Landscape design and build company in Perrysburg, Ohio, serving homes and businesses across Wood and Lucas County (Greater Toledo): paver patios and hardscapes, drainage solutions, landscape design and installation, outdoor lighting, lawn maintenance, seasonal cleanups, and snow removal. Founded by brothers Ty and Trent Lincoln. 4.9 stars from more than 220 Google reviews. BBB accredited. Free estimates.

## Service area
Perrysburg, Toledo, Maumee, Sylvania, Bowling Green, Rossford, Oregon, Waterville, Whitehouse, Holland, Ottawa Hills, Monclova, and the rest of Wood County and Lucas County, Ohio.

## Services
- [Landscape Design](https://terramorphllc.com/landscape-design.html): Terramorph designs and installs landscapes for homes and businesses in Perrysburg, Toledo, Maumee, Sylvania, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. You see the plan first: beds, plants picked for clay soil and your sun, edging, rock or mulch, and drainage checked before anything is planted. The same crew then installs it. Estimates are free.
- [Paver Patios and Hardscapes](https://terramorphllc.com/paver-patios-hardscapes.html): Terramorph builds paver patios, walkways, fire pit areas, steps, and retaining walls across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. Every patio starts below the surface with excavation, a compacted base, drainage planning, and solid edge restraint, so the pavers stay flat through Northwest Ohio freeze-thaw winters. The layout is planned around how you will use the space. Estimates are free.
- [Drainage Solutions](https://terramorphllc.com/drainage-solutions.html): Terramorph fixes standing water, soggy lawns, and runoff for homes in Perrysburg, Toledo, Maumee, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. We find where the water comes from first, then move it with grading, buried downspouts, French drains, catch basins, or dry creek beds, depending on the yard. Clay soil and flat lots are the usual causes here. Estimates are free.
- [Outdoor Lighting](https://terramorphllc.com/outdoor-lighting.html): Terramorph designs and installs low-voltage outdoor lighting for paths, entries, patios, driveways, and trees across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. Lighting is planned around how you move through the yard at night and what you want seen from the street. It can be added to an existing landscape or built into a new patio or bed. Estimates are free.
- [Lawn Maintenance](https://terramorphllc.com/lawn-maintenance.html): Terramorph provides recurring lawn maintenance for homes and businesses in Perrysburg, Toledo, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio: mowing, edging, trimming, weeding, and bed upkeep on a set schedule. The same crew can handle fall core aeration and overseeding, spring and fall cleanups, mulch refreshes, and snow removal. Estimates are free.
- [Seasonal Cleanups](https://terramorphllc.com/seasonal-cleanups.html): Terramorph does fall and spring cleanups across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. A fall cleanup clears leaves from the lawn, beds, and fence lines and hauls them away, cuts back perennials, shapes shrubs, cleans up bed edges, and finishes the lawn before winter. Commercial blowers and full crews handle big wooded lots. Estimates are free.
- [Snow Removal](https://terramorphllc.com/snow-removal.html): Terramorph provides snow removal for homes and businesses in Perrysburg, Toledo, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio: plowed driveways, shoveled and snow-blown walkways and entries, commercial lots, and salting and de-icing. Booking before the first storm gets the property covered for the season. Estimates are free.
- [Lawn Aeration and Overseeding](https://terramorphllc.com/lawn-aeration-overseeding-northwest-ohio.html): Terramorph provides core aeration and overseeding for lawns in Perrysburg, Toledo, Maumee, Sylvania, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. A stand-on core aerator pulls plugs from compacted clay soil, and seed matched to the lawn's sun and shade goes down right after, so it lands in the holes. Late August through October is the best window in Northwest Ohio. Estimates are free.
- [Shrub and Hedge Trimming](https://terramorphllc.com/shrub-hedge-trimming-northwest-ohio.html): Terramorph trims and shapes shrubs, bushes, and hedges for homes and businesses in Perrysburg, Toledo, Maumee, Sylvania, and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. Each plant is trimmed at the right time for its type so spring bloomers keep their flowers, overgrown shrubs are cut back in stages, and the clippings are hauled away. Terramorph does not do tree removal or large-tree work. Estimates are free.
- [Permaculture Design](https://terramorphllc.com/permaculture-design-toledo-ohio.html): Terramorph designs and installs permaculture landscapes for homes in Perrysburg, Toledo, Maumee, Sylvania and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio: rain gardens and water-smart grading, food-producing beds and fruit trees, native habitat and soil building, planned for heavy clay and zone 6b winters. One local crew draws the plan and builds it in phases. Estimates are free.
- [Native Landscaping](https://terramorphllc.com/native-landscaping-toledo-ohio.html): Terramorph designs and installs native plant gardens, pollinator habitat, meadows, rain gardens and invasive-plant replacements for homes across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. Plants are matched to your soil (Black Swamp clay or Oak Openings sand), beds get clean edges and a clear layout so they look designed, and we offer establishment care for the first seasons. Estimates are free.
- [Food Forests and Edible Landscaping](https://terramorphllc.com/food-forest-edible-landscaping-toledo-ohio.html): Terramorph designs and installs food forests, fruit and nut trees, berry patches, kitchen gardens and raised beds for homes in Perrysburg, Toledo and across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. Varieties and pollination partners are chosen for zone 6b and clay soil, trees go in well-drained spots, and projects can be phased, starting with trees and shrubs. Estimates are free.
- [Natural Swimming Pools and Ponds](https://terramorphllc.com/natural-swimming-pools-ponds-ohio.html): Terramorph designs and builds natural swimming pools, swim ponds, wildlife ponds, pondless waterfalls and bog filters for homes across Wood and Lucas County, Ohio. Plants, gravel and microbes clean the water instead of chlorine, the system is built for Ohio winters and Northwest Ohio clay, and we check local permit and barrier rules before building. Estimates are free.
